subtitle: Hides armor worn by players, so you can see your skin.
description:
Armor is hidden on your character in game and in the inventory, so your skin is always on show no matter what you have equipped. Your armor still works as normal, it's just invisible.

Choose which pieces are hidden in the Mods tab of the game's settings: helmets, chest armor, leggings and boots.

Requirements

  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the InvisibleArmor folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\InvisibleArmor\InvisibleArmor_P.pak

Uninstall

Delete the InvisibleArmor folder from ~mods.
